Container.Name: PasswordCheckerWeb
Container.Overview: A lightweight Flask web application that evaluates password strength using zxcvbn, checks for compromised passwords against Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) using k-Anonymity for privacy, and generates high-entropy passphrases based on the official 7,776-word EFF Large Wordlist.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage directory for application state

Config.Name: Redis Host
Config.Description: IP address or Docker container name of your Redis server (e.g. redis or 192.168.1.X).

Config.Name: Redis Password
Config.Description: Optional password for Redis authentication (leave blank if no auth required).

Config.Name: Redis URL
Config.Description: Optional direct Redis connection URI (e.g., redis://:password@192.168.1.X:6379/0). Overrides Redis Host/Port settings if set. Leave blank to use discrete Redis Host/Port.

Config.Name: Disable Telemetry
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to disable anonymous startup telemetry metrics.
